title: Belajar TEKNIK TARI KEBYAR DUDUK -Bumi Bajra-

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher demonstrates floor-based and standing sequences directly in front of the students while counting aloud. He combines verbal instructions with hands-on positioning and playful encouragement.

lesson_structure.note: Traditional offering ceremony at the temple entrance before practice
Teacher demonstrates foot and leg positioning while seated on the floor
Students practice seated foot movements alongside the teacher
Transitioning to standing postures and arm movements

steps_taught.name: Jalan Duduk
steps_taught.description: Seated footwork and shifting weight across the floor

what_works: Clear counting and breakdown of steps
what_hinders: Fast transitions between floor and standing work

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher sits on knees demonstrating foot placement and weight shift on the floor
Teacher observes students practicing floor movement and adjusts their positioning
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: audible verbal instruction details due to background noise

extraction.distinctive_method: Integrating a temple offering ritual before starting the physical dance lesson.
